preserved_history.note: Corrected proposition/evidence IR added polarity and evidence IDs in 5312967.
Audit found evaluator validated polarity syntax but initially did not consume epistemic status in policy evaluation.
A paired established/not-established control fixed that gap.
Evidence-ref resolution was tightened to exactly one ref equal to the supplied evidence_id.

pre_fix_control.cause: the frozen test control was missing typed provenance fields required by the validator during the first pass of the polarity audit

corrected_evaluation_contract.evidence_ref_rule: each assertion must contain exactly one evidence_ref equal to the supplied evidence_id

conclusion: The checker now consumes epistemic polarity rather than flattening it, so it can distinguish an unsupported positive assertion from a correctly bounded negative assertion without natural-language interpretation.
limitations: This still does not solve semantic typing acquisition/trust.
This still does not change production observation contracts.
